blocks.text: Nowadays it is very important to know everything about computers. The computer world has taken the first place in technology and advanced systems. That’s the reason why many people *have been* investigating all about the functions and the operations of these incredible machines. You can easily have information by pressing a simple button on a computer. Then you can say: *“I have been exploring a new and fantastic world”…*

items.q: Why have many people been investigating about computers?
How can you get information from a computer?

items: I have been explaining the exercises.
You have been working a lot.

We have been practicing that new rhythm.
